questions.question: Migrant labour means:
options: Working far from home for a period and then returning home
Working only on one's own farm

questions.question: Which was a pull factor that drew workers to Kimberley?
options: Wages that could buy guns, ploughs and cattle
Hut taxes in their home areas

questions.question: Why did some chiefs send young men to Kimberley in the 1870s?
options: To learn English at mission schools
To become claim owners for the British
To earn money to buy guns to strengthen their kingdoms

questions.question: In the early 1870s, migrant workers had bargaining power because they:
options: Had votes in the Cape Parliament
Could choose employers and leave when conditions were bad

questions.question: Pass laws for black workers at the diamond fields were introduced in:
Under masters and servants laws, a worker who broke a contract:
options: Could sue the employer for damages only

questions.question: Which was an aim of the employers in using passes?
options: To give workers freedom to change jobs
To stop workers deserting and to keep wages down
To help workers send money home

questions.question: The Kimberley pass system later became a model for:
options: Pass laws on the Witwatersrand and in the 20th century

questions.question: Closed compounds at Kimberley were introduced from about:
Which reason did the companies give for closed compounds?
options: To stop diamond theft and illicit diamond buying
To let workers live with their families

questions.question: When white workers struck against searching in 1884:
options: Black workers were exempted from searching
White workers were moved into closed compounds
Six strikers were killed and white workers were largely exempted from strip-searching

questions.question: Why did Kimberley shopkeepers protest against the compounds?
options: They wanted to live in the compounds
They lost the trade of thousands of workers

subtopics.title: Effects, Legacy and the Error Museum

questions.question: A worker earns 20 shillings a week for 12 weeks. How much does he earn in total?
If he spends 8 shillings a week for 12 weeks in the company store, how much returns to the company?
Which statement belongs in the error museum?
options: White workers lived in closed compounds
Migrant workers returned to rural homes

questions.question: Migrant labour allowed employers to pay low wages because:
options: Rural families were expected to support themselves while men worked away

questions.question: Which was a push factor that forced people into migrant labour?
options: Hut taxes that had to be paid in cash

questions.question: Lobola is:
Why did the mine owners dislike workers' early freedom?
options: Workers could leave and wages rose as employers competed

questions.question: What happened to a worker found without a pass?
options: He was given a new job immediately
He could be arrested, fined or jailed

questions.question: Before a worker could leave legally, his employer had to:
options: Pay his train fare to Britain
Sign his pass at the end of the contract

questions.question: Passes reduced workers' ability to:
options: Bargain for better pay by changing employers

questions.question: How long did workers usually stay inside a closed compound?
options: For the whole of their contract, usually three to six months

questions.question: At the end of a contract, workers were held and searched to:
options: Make sure no swallowed or hidden diamonds left the compound

questions.question: Which form of resistance did some workers use?
options: Deserting or selling diamonds through illicit channels
